concept: Logos reales: se reemplazan los logos generados por IA por los archivos oficiales de refs/
erase_prompt: Remove the brand logos (the "Best Vision Accounting" logo and the "IRS Protect Plus" shield logo, and any divider line between them) and the small one-line disclaimer text in the lower part of the image. Fill that area seamlessly with the natural continuation of the background behind them. Do not change anything else: every other element, all other text, people, objects, colors and the composition must stay exactly the same.
disclaimer: IRS Protect Plus es un programa de membresía y no es un seguro.
